description: This file defines stream handling interfaces and macros for the FreeType project, including stream operations, frame handling, and byte extraction macros.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Open
methods.description: Opens a stream from a file path.

methods.name: FT_Stream_New
methods.description: Creates a new stream from given arguments.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Free
methods.description: Frees a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_OpenMemory
methods.description: Initializes a stream for in-memory data.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Close
methods.description: Closes a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Skip
methods.description: Skips bytes in a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Pos
methods.description: Returns current position in stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Read
methods.description: Reads bytes from stream into buffer.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadAt
methods.description: Reads bytes at a specific position.

methods.name: FT_Stream_EnterFrame
methods.description: Enters a frame of bytes in stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ExitFrame
methods.description: Exits a stream frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ExtractFrame
methods.description: Extracts a frame of data from stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReleaseFrame
methods.description: Releases an extracted frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetChar
methods.description: Reads a byte from an entered frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetShort
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian integer from a frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetOffset
methods.description: Reads a 24-bit big-endian integer from a frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetLong
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian integer from a frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetShortLE
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian integer from a frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_GetLongLE
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian integer from a frame.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadChar
methods.description: Reads a byte from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadShort
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadOffset
methods.description: Reads a 24-bit big-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadLong
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadShortLE
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadLongLE
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_ReadFields
methods.description: Reads a structure from a stream based on field descriptions.
